# generator

```go
import "katenary.io/internal/generator"
```

Package generator generates kubernetes objects from a "compose" file and transforms them into a helm chart.

The generator package is the core of katenary. It is responsible for generating kubernetes objects from a compose file and transforming them into a helm chart. Conversion manipulates Yaml representation of kubernetes object to add conditions, labels, annotations, etc. to the objects. It also create the values to be set to the values.yaml file.

The generate.Convert\(\) create an HelmChart object and call "Generate\(\)" method to convert from a compose file to a helm chart. It saves the helm chart in the given directory.

If you want to change or override the write behavior, you can use the HelmChart.Generate\(\) function and implement your own write function. This function returns the helm chart object containing all kubernetes objects and helm chart ingormation. It does not write the helm chart to the disk.

<a name="Generate"></a>
### func [Generate](<https://repo.katenary.io/Katenary/katenary/blob/feature/security-network-policies/internal/generator/generator.go#L39>)

```go
func Generate(project *types.Project) (*HelmChart, error)
```

Generate creates a HelmChart from a docker\-compose project. It does not write files to disk but returns the HelmChart object with all templates.

The function performs the following steps:

1. Computes a hash of compose files and adds it as an annotation.
2. Removes services marked with the "ignore" label.
3. Fixes container and resource names \(removes dashes\).
4. Detects the main app and sets the chart version.
5. Creates deployments for all services.
6. Creates PVCs and ConfigMaps for volumes.
7. Merges same\-pod services into their target deployments.
8. Creates init containers for services with depends\_on relationships.
9. Generates RBAC resources for services needing K8s API access.
10. Generates ConfigMaps and Secrets from environment variables.
11. Applies shared configuration from env\-from labels.
12. Generates Kubernetes Service resources for services with ports.
13. Processes YAML templates by replacing placeholders and computing indentation.
14. Generates helper templates.
